# Payment gateways

<!-- Generated by `composer docs:generate` from each gateway's describe() and the conformance suite's rules. Do not edit this file: change the declaration and regenerate. -->

A payment gateway declares, in its `describe()`, what it can do: the operations it supports in each currency, for a provider account of each country, how its provider keeps idempotency keys, and the external services it calls. SEOCart refuses an operation the gateway's matrix does not declare before any request reaches the provider, and offers the gateway at checkout only where its matrix declares `authorize`. A gateway plugin publishes the same page of its own gateway as `docs/capabilities.md`, generated with `php ../seocart/bin/generate-docs.php --plugin=.` from its root.

SEOCart itself registers one gateway, the stand-in, on a site that is not in production.

## Stand-in gateway (`stub`)

- Written against the payment contract 0.2.0.
- Modes: test.
- Settings: none.
- External services: none: it calls no external service.

### Capability matrix

| Currency | Account country | `authorize` | `capture` | `partial_capture` | `multi_capture` | `void` | `refund` | `partial_refund` | `off_session` | `sca` | `query` | `query_refund` | `webhooks` |
| -------- | --------------- | ----------- | --------- | ----------------- | --------------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------- | ------------- | ----- | ------- | -------------- | ---------- |
| EUR      | any             | yes         | yes       | yes               | no              | yes    | yes      | yes              | no            | yes   | yes     | yes            | yes        |
| GBP      | any             | yes         | yes       | yes               | no              | yes    | yes      | yes              | no            | yes   | yes     | yes            | yes        |
| USD      | any             | yes         | yes       | yes               | no              | yes    | yes      | yes              | no            | yes   | yes     | yes            | yes        |

### Idempotency

| Key retention | Searchable by the store's references | Search delay |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------ |
| no key        | yes                                  | 0 seconds    |

## Conformance rules

SEOCart's payment gateway conformance suite holds every gateway to these rules, the stand-in included. A gateway plugin's test extends `SEOCart\Tests\Conformance\Payment\GatewayConformanceCase` and runs with `sh ../seocart/bin/ci/extension.sh conformance . payments` (`docs/writing-an-extension.md` shows how). The plant of a rule is a gateway, in `tests/Conformance/Payment/Plants/`, that breaks it and that the suite must fail.

| #   | Rule                                     | The suite asserts                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Proof                                                             | Plant                                                                                                               |
| --- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | Ledger shape                             | After an authorization, a capture, a partial refund and a full refund, the payment ledger, the intent and the order hold exactly the rows and amounts those operations make, and each outcome names its own object, one the provider's answer holds and never the long-lived intent.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | the suite, on the tape                                            | `CaptureReportedAsAuthorization`, `ObjectIsTheIntent`                                                               |
| 2   | Matrix matches behaviour                 | Every operation a cell of the matrix declares succeeds; every optional operation it does not declare, and every operation the plugin can ask in a currency it has no row for (authorize, capture, void, query and refund), is refused before any request; a gateway that declares no `sca` never asks the customer to act.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | the suite, on the tape                                            | `PartialRefundRefundsAll`                                                                                           |
| 3   | Availability never looser                | The gateway is never offered where its cell does not declare `authorize`, and `isAvailable()` answers from its context alone: no request, no query, the same answer twice.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | the suite, without a tape                                         | `AvailabilityAsksProvider`                                                                                          |
| 4   | No card fields                           | No property or parameter of the contract's classes or of the gateway's own is named like card or bank account data.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | the suite's unit group                                            | `CardNumberProperty`                                                                                                |
| 5   | Amount and currency echoed               | Every answer reports the amount and currency it was asked for.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | the suite, on the tape                                            | `AmountInAnotherCurrency`                                                                                           |
| 6   | Idempotency keys as ruled                | Every request that moves money carries the idempotency key the plugin derived for its operation, its request's own (a capture's and a void's are not the intent's), in a header or its body, never only in its URL, for a provider without keys too, and a request asked again carries the same.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | the suite, on the tape                                            | `FreshKeyPerCall`, `IdempotencyKeyInUrl`, `KeylessSendsTheUuid`                                                     |
| 7   | Already done answers the same            | A capture or void asked again after its answer was lost answers the same provider object and outcome.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | the suite, on the tape                                            | `AlreadyCapturedThrows`                                                                                             |
| 8   | Not-found authority                      | A provider that never saw an intent or made a refund answers nothing or a not-found, the latter only when it can be searched; the plugin acts on a not-found only after the search delay; an intent the provider authorized is never not found, one it declined is answered declined, and one it is still deciding nothing or pending.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | the suite, on the tape                                            | `NotFoundAtOnce`                                                                                                    |
| 9   | Expiry                                   | An intent the provider cancelled once its wait ended is answered `expired`, and the placement ends as a decline does.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | the suite, on the tape                                            | `NeverExpires`                                                                                                      |
| 10  | Webhooks verified before parsed          | A delivery with a bad signature, an old or future timestamp, or a malformed body with a bad signature is rejected without an exception; the same delivery read twice gives the same event id; a payment event reads as its result, and any other event as ignored; and the store's webhook route, given the same deliveries, decides each as the gateway read it, by what each does to its event's receipt: a rejected one refused with no receipt changed, an ignored one kept in a receipt of its own as ignored for its type, a result settled, and the same delivery sent again changes nothing. | the suite, on the tape                                            | `DecodesBeforeVerifying`, `AnswersARedeliveryIgnored`                                                               |
| 11  | Next action shape                        | A next action is a redirect to an https page (or straight back to the store's return URL) that holds no credential and no card number, or a step of the provider's script with its handle.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | the suite, on the tape                                            | `SecretInActionUrl`                                                                                                 |
| 12  | Every call through the client at depth 0 | Every request goes through the HTTP client the plugin gives the gateway, outside any transaction: the gateway's source calls no other network API, and each payment operation (an authorization, a capture, each refund, a void) sends a request of its own through the client.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | the suite, on the tape, and the suite's unit group for the source | `DirectWordPressCall`, `AnswersWithoutTheClient`, `CapturesPastTheClient`, `CurlCall`, `CurlByName`, `CurlImported` |
| 13  | No raw response or card data in a log    | No line the gateway logs holds a provider's answer, the provider's words in one (such as an error's message or a one-word status, found however the line encodes, cases or splits them) unless the gateway's test declares them one of the provider's codes, a card field or a card number.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | the suite, on the tape                                            | `LogsTheResponse`, `LogsTheErrorMessage`, `LogsTheMessageEncoded`, `LogsTheMessageInWords`                          |
| 14  | Credentials never leave                  | No request URL, header but `Authorization`, or log line holds a credential, and no tape holds a credential, a value shaped like a secret, an opaque token in no public shape the gateway's test declares, a card number, or a field named for a card's verification code or full number; a recording keeps no response header but `content-type` and those the test declares, and drops the rest unread.                                                                                                                                                                                             | the suite, on the tape                                            | `KeyInQuery`                                                                                                        |
| 15  | `describe()` is data                     | describe(), called outside WordPress, calls no WordPress function but the pure helpers such as `absint()`, translates nothing, and adds, removes or runs no hook.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | the suite's unit group                                            | `ReadsAnOption`                                                                                                     |
| 16  | Mode                                     | A test-mode payment's requests carry the test credential and a live-mode payment's the live one, never the other.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | the suite, without a tape                                         | `IgnoresMode`                                                                                                       |
| 17  | Void answers an approval already given   | A void the plugin sends when the customer's time to act ran out, after the provider had already approved, answers that authorization's approval with its charge.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | the suite, on the tape                                            | `VoidAfterApprovalFails`                                                                                            |
| 18  | Idle budget of the extension             | With the extension active, a request that needs no gateway costs at most one more hook, one more file and no query.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | the extension kit: `sh bin/ci/extension.sh idle <extension root>` | the kit's own                                                                                                       |
| 19  | Void reports the amount it released      | An approved void reports the request's amount as the amount it moved: what the cancellation released; it names the provider's cancellation, or the intent where the provider makes none.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | the suite, on the tape                                            | `VoidReportsZero`                                                                                                   |

Rule 12's reading of the source names the calls it can see by name: cURL, sockets, a URL written in the source and read as a file, WordPress's HTTP API, and the HTTP clients and providers' SDKs it knows by namespace (Guzzle, Symfony's and PSR-18 clients, Requests, and the SDKs of Stripe, Braintree, PayPal, Authorize.Net, Adyen, Square, Mollie, Razorpay and Omnipay), whether called directly, named whole in a string as a callable or a variable function's value, or imported with `use function`. A URL held in a variable, a name built at run time, or a library it does not know, is beyond it; the rule's run-time half covers those, as each payment operation (the authorization, the capture, each refund and the void) must send a request of its own, one that moves money and names the operation's key, through the plugin's client. That half takes any such request for the operation's own: it proves an adapter that sends its calls through the client, not one built to send the money call past it and another request with the same key through it.

Rule 13 takes for the provider's words a value of its answers that has whitespace in it or is one word of letters: a one-word value with `_` or a digit in it is taken for a code or an id, which a log line may carry, and two spellings that differ only by Unicode normalisation are not taken for the same words.

Rule 14 reads a recording value by value for an opaque token of 20 characters or more: a secret shorter than that, or one split across values, is beyond that reading, so every credential of the run is a secret setting the gateway declares, replaced in every form it is sent in, and every secret the provider issues is named in its test's `providerSecrets()`. A field's name is not held to the token rule, as providers name fields with 20 characters and more, so a secret sent as a field's name is beyond it. A form-encoded copy of a placeholder the scrub itself wrote passes as that placeholder, which names a declared setting and carries no value: the tape keeps the placeholder's text, and a replay has that text where the provider sent the encoded copy. A card number is refused wherever it is, and a card's verification code or full number by the name of its field, `cvc`, `cvv`, `cvv2`, `cvc2`, `csc`, `security_code`, `number`, `card_number` or `account_number`, whatever its value: a verification code under any other name is beyond the reading, as three or four digits read as any number. A card's `last4`, `exp_month`, `exp_year`, `brand`, `funding` and `country` are kept.
